content.text:
The bug was in `ledger/currency.py`. `to_cents` used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. Float error turns `19.99 * 100` into `1998.9999…`, so it came out as 1998 cents instead of 1999. It now uses `int(round(amount * 100))`.

All three failing tests had that one cause, since `subtotal` and the discount total both go through `to_cents`. I ran the full suite and all 5 tests pass.

`round` fixes the float noise but still assumes the input has at most two decimal places. A price like `0.005` would round to a whole cent without any warning.
